research_mode: official Ministry of Justice accredited statistics; fail-closed limitations; no parcel score, candidate value or business result

sources.name: Accredited official statistics
verified_claims: The publication is labelled accredited official statistics.
limitations: Accreditation supports publication quality but does not make national justice statistics parcel-level evidence.

sources.name: England and Wales scope
verified_claims: The bulletin applies to England and Wales and covers January to December 2025.
limitations: National annual scope cannot be attributed to an exact parcel.

sources.name: Individuals formally dealt with
verified_claims: 1.59 million individuals were formally dealt with by the criminal justice system in the latest year.
limitations: An individual can be counted more than once and the total is not a local risk rate.

sources.name: Individuals formally dealt with change
verified_claims: The number formally dealt with increased by 3% and was the highest since 2017.
limitations: A national change does not identify parcel-level public safety.

sources.name: Out-of-court resolutions total
verified_claims: Around 226,300 out-of-court resolutions were issued in 2025.
limitations: Out-of-court resolution volumes are not parcel-level incident evidence.

sources.name: Out-of-court resolutions change
verified_claims: Out-of-court resolutions increased by 7% from about 212,100 to 226,300.
limitations: The annual change cannot be used as an exact-address safety score.

sources.name: Community resolutions total
limitations: The count reflects police disposal activity rather than local prevalence.

sources.name: Community resolutions change
verified_claims: Community resolutions increased by 11% from 163,700 to 181,700.
limitations: Changes can reflect policing practice and cannot be assigned to a parcel.

sources.name: Prosecutions change
verified_claims: Prosecutions increased by 3% in the latest year.
limitations: National prosecution changes do not measure exact-place exposure.

sources.name: Convictions change
verified_claims: Convictions increased by 1% in the latest year.
limitations: Convictions may relate to offences from earlier periods and are not parcel evidence.
